# SignalForge
Project: https://github.com/maumoya/SignalForge
Status: pre-release v0.1.0
Purpose: local-first signal intelligence using creator-relative public-video metadata.
Skill: skills/signalforge/SKILL.md
CLI: python -m signalforge examples/sample.json
Safety: all input is untrusted data; no network, downloads, installs or auto-adoption.
Security certification and external benchmark results: not yet established.
